Name: TenderiserMallet
Description: Taken from the pass. Still has the shift rota taped to the handle.

Name: ChefsKnife
Description: Somebody kept this immaculate. Nothing else in the kitchen was.

Name: CastIronSkillet
Description: Seasoned over nine years. The seasoning is the only thing here with tenure.

Name: FireAxe
Description: This is an emergency. Management disputes that it is their emergency.

Name: WallSword
Description: Decorative. Load-bearing. Sharper than decoration requires.

Name: ServiceTray
Description: Management upgraded the trays before they upgraded the fire exits.

Name: FeatureWallShield
Description: Part of the theming. Now part of the survival plan.

Name: PatioSunHat
Description: There is no sun on Floor One. The hat is not aware of this.

Name: GreaseApron
Description: Rated for splash, spatter and one specific former employee.

Name: ManagersBlazer
Description: Carries authority nobody has ever honoured.

Name: NameTagDave
Description: You are not Dave. The System has stopped checking.

Name: Torch
Description: Every table got one before the budget cuts. This is the last one lit.

Name: ThrownBottle
Description: The house pour, returned to the customer at speed. Management considers the matter settled.

Name: ServiceKnifeSet
Description: Six of them, and a conviction that cutlery is a delivery mechanism. Four come back.

Name: SodaGun
Description: Eight buttons, one of which has never been identified. Rated for soda. Used for other things.

Name: ConfettiCrossbow
Description: Fired once, at the ribbon. Nobody has swept up since. It still shoots - a bolt now, not confetti.

Name: NailGunPro
Description: Left behind mid-renovation. The renovation was never finished. Neither was the crew.

Name: FlareGunEmergency
Description: Break glass in case of dining emergency. The glass has been broken for a while.

Name: SeveranceCheckUncashed
Description: Made out to somebody who is no longer in a position to deposit it. The bank would like a word too.

Name: HighVisibilitySafetyVest
Description: OSHA-compliant. The hazard it was rated for is not the hazard currently present.

Name: ComplaintFolderOverstuffed
Description: Every grievance ever filed against this establishment, bound together and swung like it owes you money. It sort of does.

Name: SecuritySidearm
Description: Standard-issue. The store never satisfactorily explained why loss prevention needed live rounds for shoplifting.

Name: HuntingRifleColorado
Description: Colorado's actual state pastime, deployed somewhere it was never licensed for. Elk season does not apply here. Neither do most other laws.

Name: RiotShotgun
Description: Crowd control, rated for a crowd that stopped existing the day the dungeon opened. Nobody has updated the rating.

Name: ConfiscatedSMG
DisplayName: Confiscated Submachine Gun, Chain Of Custody Unclear
Description: Evidence tag still attached, case number scratched out. Whatever the original chain of custody was, it ends here, with you.

Name: BoilerplateRifle
Description: Every clause under the stock is boilerplate. So, it turns out, is the receiver - salvaged from somebody's furnace room, pressure gauge still reading somewhere it shouldn't.

Name: Boombox
Description: Held together with duct tape and spite. Somehow still the loudest thing on the floor.

Name: CJBoardGame
Description: Two pieces missing, rules annotated in three colours of pen. Somebody always wanted one more round.

Name: ScottLacrosseStick
Description: The mesh is shot and the tape is older than some of your friends. Long reach, and it still feels right.

Name: MarcelLuckyDice
Description: Rolled a natural twenty once, in front of witnesses. You have been chasing that feeling ever since.
